the co-development of sustainability assessment frameworks is a valuable process to build the capacity of practitioners, to identify key areas of intervention and to develop new partnerships for action.

the co-development of a sustainability framework with a broad range of actors, and the subsequent application of this framework, can provide a powerful tool for engaging with stakeholders, raising awareness and building capacity for change.
